newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Guangxi region arrests eight arms dealers.
newsitem.headline: China's Guangxi region arrests eight arms dealers.

text.p: Police in China's southern region of Guangxi arrested eight people for arms trafficking last month and seized 15 handguns, the China News Service said on Tuesday.
The People's Armed Police border defence unit in Ningming county arrested the arms dealers in three separate cases, the agency said.
The arms dealers included foreigners, it said, but did not say how many or give their nationalities.
